newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to host 1998 world gas conference.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to host 1998 world gas conference.

text.p: Australia will host the 1998 world gas conference to be held in Perth, Western Australia, Australian Gas Association chairman Greg Harvey said on Monday.
"The LNG 12 conference in Perth will be a major undertaking for the association, the North West Shelf participants and all interested companies," Harvey said in a speech to an AGA convention.
The conference, a meeting place for the world's top gas producers and pipeline participants, is expected to attract about 2,000 international delegates, an AGA spokesman said.
The conference is held every three years with the last conference at Birmingham, England in 1995.
Harvey also said the AGA had formulated a new environmental code of practice which established principles to be adopted by the Australian industry.
"It covers practices for new development projects and operating and maintenance activities. Reporting will commence later this year," Harvey said.
He also told the convention the federal government's gas reform task force which was developing a plan for gas access to transmission and distribution systems was "fundamentally deficient."
"The draft proposals are intrusive, work against comercial negotiations and will lead to adversarial situations," he said.
"These may not accomodate the needs of all sectors of the gas market, especially residential customers," he said.
"Gas market development in Australia must be conducive to high levels of private sector project development," Harvey said.
